column1: # Accepted CodeQL findings. The gate in pr-checks.yml ignores exactly
# these, and nothing else. Changing this file takes a pull request.

column3: The Reolink firmware takes the session token as a query parameter on GET (Snap, Download, /flv) and has no header alternative; the simulator must accept it the same way. Tokens are never logged: request records keep the path without the query (test/redaction.test.ts).

The simulated camera API reproduces the firmware, which does not rate-limit; cam-sim is a test tool, and rate limiting would change what clients under test see. The control API needs a bearer token compared in constant time.
Test-only: connects to the simulator's self-signed factory certificate on purpose, to read back which certificate is being served.
Test-only: connects to the control port's self-signed factory certificate on purpose, to read back which certificate is being served.
